records.name: Groundnut Oil

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides dietary fat and predominantly unsaturated fatty acids.
cautions: Allergy risk for people with peanut allergy depending on processing.
records.servingSuggestions: Use measured amounts for cooking rather than free-pouring.
records.selectionTips: Choose sealed food-grade oil with clear label and valid date.
records.storageTips: Keep tightly closed away from heat and light.
